item.title: Barcelona sign Brazil forward Kerolin from Manchester City for club-record £1.25m
item.description:
A Record-Breaking Transfer: Barcelona Sign Kerolin for £1.25m

Barcelona have made a major coup in the transfer market, securing the services of Brazil forward Kerolin from Manchester City for a club-record £1.25m. The signing is a significant statement of intent from the defending European champions, who are understood to believe Kerolin has the pace and trickery on the ball to become a regular goalscorer in the Champions League.

The transfer fee eclipses Olivia Smith’s £1m move to Arsenal in 2025 and Melvine Malard’s £850,000 switch from Manchester United to Chelsea, making it the largest sum received for a sale by a Women’s Super League side. Kerolin, 26, was part of the City side that won the WSL title and the Women’s FA Cup last season, and was with the club for 18 months after arriving from North Carolina Courage in January 2025.
